headline: Google Earth's AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summary: Google launched an AI tool for Google Earth. It allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts. The feature was shut down after just one day due to misuse potential.

headline: NHTSA investigates 1.2 million Tesla vehicles for suspension failure
summary: The NHTSA is probing 1.2 million Tesla Model 3 and Y vehicles. Complaints allege suspension failure causing loss of control. The preliminary investigation covers 2018-2023 models.

headline: Google rumored to launch 'Pixel Tag' item tracker
summary: Google appears to be developing an item tracker named 'Pixel Tag.' An image and store listing reveal an oval-shaped gadget with a speaker. It would compete directly with Apple's AirTag.

headline: Banning robot vacuums could worsen privacy and security
summary: Robot vacuums gather extensive data on homes, including maps, routines, and sometimes camera/mic feeds. A ban might limit choices and increase prices without enhancing safety. As AI improves, privacy risks are escalating with these devices.

headline: MSI Codex Z2 Gaming PC with RTX 5070 Ti drops to $1,699
summary: Get a 4K-ready MSI Codex Z2 gaming PC for $1,699. This deal includes a significant $600 discount. The RTX 5070 Ti GPU alone typically costs $950-$1000.

headline: Multi-function power cage for home gym just $263.48
summary: Upgrade your home gym with a complete multi-function power cage. It serves as a squat rack, lat pull-down machine, power tower, and dip bar. Priced at just $263.48 with free shipping.

headline: Black Panther, Namor, Doom central to Marvel's 2026 'Armageddon'
summary: Black Panther, Namor, and Doctor Doom are key to Marvel's 'Avengers: Armageddon' in 2026. The conflict is too vast for a single comic book. Expect a major spinoff series, 'Black Panther/Namor: Doomed.'

headline: Save 40% on new 2026 Hisense U6 4K Fire TV
summary: Get 40% off the new 2026 Hisense U6 4K Fire TV. Features Hi-QLED Mini-LED technology for stunning visuals. It's a top budget TV choice for 4K HDR movies and PS5 gaming.

headline: Spain's PM blames traffickers as 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta
summary: Spain's Prime Minister blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants arrived in Ceuta from Morocco. Most migrants reportedly returned to Morocco by Friday evening. Italy has suspended its Schengen agreement with Spain.

headline: Moroccan police clash with migrants near Ceuta border
summary: Moroccan police clashed with migrants attempting to cross into Spain's Ceuta. Over 25,000 migrants have voluntarily returned. The incident highlights ongoing border tensions.

headline: Top Fifa official questions Infantino's World Cup plan
summary: A senior Fifa official strongly criticizes Gianni Infantino's plan to sell stakes in competitions. The official stated he's willing to lose his job over his opposition. This reveals significant internal dissent within Fifa.

headline: Families say 20-year sentence not enough for funeral director Robert Bush
summary: Families react to the 20-year sentence given to funeral director Robert Bush. They express that no sentence is long enough for his crimes. The case has deeply affected the victims' families.
